_about: Title rules for collect_postings.py (SEARCH_RULES), applied before any text is read. Each value is a regular expression, case-insensitive; a key left out does not count. forms_out: another language's title form; low: a level too low; level and senior: the level words (one is needed); senior_need and senior_no: a title whose only level word is a senior one needs senior_need and none of senior_no; no: words to drop; soft_no: dropped unless the title also holds a need word; need: an engineering word. Made-up example for a backend lead.
